tips.text: The pyramid stair event pulls the whole troll army; hold the top of the stairs and pick up adds as they arrive.
Stay at the top of the stairs during the event; sandfury shaman packs need interrupts.
Use the Mallet of Zul'Farrak at the gong for Gahz'rilla; collect Scarab Shells as you clear.
Run Zul'Farrak once. Do not reset for another Gahz'rilla.
At most five dungeon entries/resets per hour. Kill XP inside dungeons is increased by 50%. If any party member would get no XP because the mobs are trivial to them, nobody in the party gets XP.
